PREFIX owl: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/owl#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?case ?finding ?hazard ?hazardLabel ?match
WHERE {
  ?case a app:InspectionCase .
  ?case core:hasHazardFinding ?finding .
  ?finding a app:HazardFinding .
  ?finding core:mapsHazard ?hazard .
  ?hazard a haz:Hazard .
  OPTIONAL { ?hazard rdfs:label ?hazardLabel . }
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?hazardLabel)), "안전난간") || CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?hazardLabel)), "난간"))
  OPTIONAL { ?finding core:hasSituationMatch ?match .
             ?match a app:SituationMatch . }
}
LIMIT 100

SELECT ?safetyRequirement ?workProcess ?srId ?wpName ?safetyText
WHERE {
  ?safetyRequirement a sr:SafetyRequirement ;
                     identifier ?srId ;
                     text ?safetyText ;
                     hasRequirementType ?reqType ;
                     derivedFromNS ?derivedNS .

  ?safetyRequirement guide:hasWorkProcess ?workProcess .
  ?workProcess a guide:WorkProcess ;
               identifier ?wpId ;
               processName ?wpName .

  ?workProcess guide:processOrder ?phase .

  ?safetyRequirement core:requiresSubjectRole ?dutyRole .
  ?dutyRole a core:SubjectRole .

  ?dutyRole core:roleName "사업주" .
}
LIMIT 100

PREFIX core: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology#>
PREFIX app: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/app#>
PREFIX pen: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/penalty#>
PREFIX law: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/law#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?exposure ?exposureStatus ?sanctionType
WHERE {
  ?exposure a app:PenaltyExposure .
  ?exposure app:exposureDirectness "DIRECT" .

  OPTIONAL {
    ?exposure app:hasPenaltyExposureStatus ?exposureStatus .
  }

  ?exposure a app:PenaltyExposure .
  ?exposure pen:hasSanctionType ?sanctionType .
  ?sanctionType a pen:SanctionType .

  # 실제 그래프에서 penalty exposure가 penalty rule/조건과 연결된 경우가 있으므로, 연결 고리를 보강
  ?rule a pen:PenaltyRule .
  ?rule pen:hasCondition ?cond .
  OPTIONAL { ?rule pen:hasPenaltyRule ?rule . }
}
LIMIT 100

PREFIX app: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/app#>
PREFIX pen: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/penalty#>
PREFIX law: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/law#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?condition
       (IF(BOUND(?status) && ?condition = ?statusCond, "SATISFIES", "UNKNOWN") AS ?satisfaction)
WHERE {
  ?exposure a app:PenaltyExposure .
  ?exposure app:hasPenaltyExposureStatus ?status .
  ?status a app:PenaltyExposureStatus .

  ?rule a pen:PenaltyRule .
  ?rule pen:hasCondition ?condition .

  # 조건-노출 상태가 실제로 연결되는 그래프 패턴을 확인하기 위해, 
  # status가 condition을 참조하는 경우를 보강(가능한 경우만)
  OPTIONAL {
    ?status pen:refersToCondition ?statusCond .
  }
}
LIMIT 100

PREFIX law: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/law#>
PREFIX core: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?modality ?bindingForce ?exemptedBy
WHERE {
  # Exemption 모달리티 인스턴스(있는 경우)
  ?modality a core:Modality .
  ?modality core:modalityType "Exemption" .
  ?modality core:hasBindingForce ?bindingForce .

  # 면책 사유로 연결되는 exemptedBy
  ?ns a law:NormStatement .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?ns core:exemptedBy ?exemptedBy .
  }
}
LIMIT 100

PREFIX sr: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/sr#>
PREFIX law: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/law#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?article ?req1 ?req2
WHERE {
  ?req1 a sr:SafetyRequirement .
  ?req1 sr:basedOnSR ?ns1 .

  ?ns1 law:hasSourceArticle ?article .

  ?req2 a sr:SafetyRequirement .
  ?req2 sr:basedOnSR ?ns2 .
  ?ns2 law:hasSourceArticle ?article .

  FILTER(?req1 != ?req2)
}
LIMIT 100

PREFIX sr: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/sr#>
PREFIX haz: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/risk/hazard#>
PREFIX risk: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/risk#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?hazard ?reqA ?reqB ?dependency
WHERE {
  ?reqA a sr:SafetyRequirement .
  ?reqA haz:addressesHazard ?hazard .

  ?reqB a sr:SafetyRequirement .
  ?reqB haz:addressesHazard ?hazard .

  FILTER(?reqA != ?reqB)

  # dependency(관계) 추론: 실제 graph에 의존하는 속성이 있을 수 있으므로
  # guide interlink/requirement dependency가 있다면 그 패턴을 우선 사용
  OPTIONAL {
    ?reqA ?dependency ?reqB .
  }
}
LIMIT 100

PREFIX guide: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/guide#>
PREFIX sr: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/sr#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?spec ?requirement
WHERE {
  ?spec a guide:EquipmentSpec .
  ?spec guide:specForSR ?requirement .
  ?requirement a sr:SafetyRequirement .

  # equipment spec가 core condition 역할로 제시되는 경우를 보강(있으면)
  OPTIONAL { ?spec guide:specRole "CoreCondition" . }
}
LIMIT 100

PREFIX core: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology#>
PREFIX sr: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/sr#>
PREFIX law: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/law#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?authority ?article ?requirement
WHERE {
  ?authority a core:RegulatoryAuthority .

  # authority가 집행을 위해 참조하는 article
  ?authority core:refersTo ?requirement .
  ?requirement a sr:SafetyRequirement .

  ?requirement sr:basedOnSR ?ns .
  ?ns law:hasSourceArticle ?article .
  ?article a law:Article .
}
LIMIT 100

PREFIX guide: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/guide#>
PREFIX app: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/app#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?checkItem ?docReq
WHERE {
  ?checkItem a guide:ChecklistItem .

  # checklist item 별 문서 요구사항
  ?checkItem guide:requiresDocumentRequirement ?docReq .
  ?docReq a guide:DocumentRequirement .
}
LIMIT 100

PREFIX pen: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/penalty#>
PREFIX app: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/app#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?exposure ?rule ?sanction
WHERE {
  ?exposure a app:PenaltyExposure .

  # 벌칙 심각도 기준 이상
  ?rule a pen:PenaltyRule .
  ?rule pen:severityScore ?severity .

  FILTER(?severity >= 0.8)

  ?rule pen:hasSanction ?sanction .
  ?sanction a pen:SanctionType .
}
LIMIT 100

PREFIX core: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology#>
PREFIX law: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/law#>
PREFIX sr: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/sr#>
PREFIX app: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/app#>
PREFIX risk: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/risk#>
PREFIX haz: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/risk/hazard#>

SELECT ?photo ?situationMatch ?sr ?article ?violatedArticle
WHERE {
  ?photo a app:UploadedPhoto .
  ?photo app:hasSituationMatch ?situationMatch .
  ?situationMatch a app:SituationMatch .
  ?situationMatch app:matchedSafetyRequirement ?sr .
  ?sr a sr:SafetyRequirement .

  ?penRule a core:SafetyRequirement .

  ?penRule sr:violatedArticle ?article .
  BIND(?penRule AS ?violatedArticle)
}
LIMIT 100

PREFIX core: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology#>

PREFIX sr: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/sr#>

SELECT ?hazardFinding ?hazard ?safetyRequirement ?article ?basedOn

  ?hazardFinding app:findingHazard ?hazard .
  ?hazardFinding app:connectedSafetyRequirement ?safetyRequirement .
  ?safetyRequirement a sr:SafetyRequirement .

  ?safetyRequirement sr:basedOnSR ?basedOn .
  ?basedOn a law:Article .
  BIND(?basedOn AS ?article)
}

  ?hazardFinding app:violatesSafetyRequirement ?safetyRequirement .
